_rationale: CollectFolio community-free-access derived-forecast publication rationale (T5, tracked deviation from T1). Decision owner: Kevin Yang. T1's TCGCSV research-only review (analytics/manifests/tcgcsv-surging-sparks-current-v2.json, assert_tcgcsv_research_terms) intentionally bars ALL public/commercial use of TCGCSV's raw ingested data -- that review and that assertion are UNCHANGED by this record. Separately, Kevin decided CollectFolio's OWN derived forecast statistics (trajectory-v1 component-weight predictions computed on top of TCGCSV pricing -- quantile paths, medianPath, confidence tiers -- never TCGCSV's raw per-observation price data itself) may be published publicly and free of community access, gated strictly by the T4 walk-forward-honest holdout serving-eligibility gate (docs/receipts/trajectory-v1/evaluation-summary.md): only cohorts that pass are served, and cold-start forecasts are served everywhere with explicit labeling per PRD Sec4 hard criterion 3b. No TCGCSV raw price display and no TCGCSV catalog metadata are published under this record -- those permissions remain False. This document_hash is a placeholder computed from this rationale note pending an official written community-free-access policy artifact from Kevin; flagged here so the deviation and its provisional nature are visible in review, not silently assumed.
